title: Local product page connection restored
summary: Restarted the local Next.js server with network access to restore Supabase product data and image loading.

changes.detail: Replaced the restricted local server process with a network-enabled process on port 3000. Application source and database records were not changed; listed files identify the affected runtime configuration and data reader.

validation.name: Product-page browser check
validation.detail: Ferrari product page returned HTTP 200 with the correct title and H1, zero captured page errors, and four checked optimized images loaded successfully.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: No deployment, checkout test or full regression run. Fix applies to the local server process.
